listen.title: What the Risk Memo Says (Report Only)
listen.text: This is how you report a risk memo in English, without endorsing it. Before the Hong Kong open, prices are from Wednesday's close, USDHKD is 7.8445, and total assets are 9,564,301 Hong Kong dollars. Tencent is 29.6 percent, PDD is 24.0 percent, Meituan is 9.5 percent, Alibaba is 7.1 percent, and Xiaomi is 2.6 percent. The memo flags two hard breaches: Zhipu is 8.4 percent against a 5 percent position limit, overweight by 3.4 percentage points, about 321,885 dollars. Kingsoft Cloud combined is 10.2 percent against the same cap, overweight by 5.2 points, about 496,505 dollars. Cash is 8.7 percent, 1.3 points below the 10 percent cash buffer, short by about 126,430 dollars. The memo says Kingsoft Cloud and Zhipu must be trimmed at least to 5 percent, plans to cut Alibaba to about 4 percent, and marks GOOGL as do-not-buy for now. It also says suggest no new orders — a paraphrase of the memo, not advice from this practice.

speak.prompt: You are my English risk-memo coach. I paraphrase a Chinese risk memo — label, never endorse. Facts (HK pre-open; Wednesday's close; USDHKD 7.8445; total HKD 9,564,301): Zhipu 8.4% vs 5% position limit (+3.4pp, ~HKD 321,885). Kingsoft Cloud combined 10.2% vs 5% (+5.2pp, ~HKD 496,505). Cash 8.7%, 1.3 points below the 10% cash buffer, short ~HKD 126,430; cash from an October 13 report. Memo wording: must trim Kingsoft Cloud and Zhipu at least to 5%; plan to cut Alibaba to ~4%; GOOGL do-not-buy now; suggest no new orders. X brief: Meta revised its AI infrastructure equity raise to ~97.5 billion dollars; AMD invests 1 billion. OpenAI reportedly plans to buy Google TPUs. Airbnb will issue temporary phone numbers in the US and Canada. Sentiment: Tencent 3.6 ('Baidu-ization'); Meituan 9.4 (small sample); Zhipu 8.5. Drill: framing → 40 seconds → one follow-up. Prefer According to the memo.... Never turn the memo into advice. Language practice only, not investment advice.
questions: Open in 20 seconds with 'According to the risk memo...': two position-limit breaches and cash vs the buffer.
Explain 'overweight' and 'trim' with Zhipu's numbers. End: 'I am reporting the memo, not giving advice.'
Guest: 'So should we sell Alibaba?' Reply: the memo plans a cut to about 4%; this practice does not endorse trades.
In 30 seconds: Meta's equity raise (~97.5 billion) and AMD's 1 billion. Mark OpenAI's TPU plan as 'reportedly'.
Close in 15 seconds: Tencent sentiment 3.6 vs Meituan 9.4 (small sample). No buy/sell lines.
speak.tip: 转述：According to the risk memo... / The memo flags... / I am paraphrasing, not advising。“position limit”仓位上限；“cash buffer”现金缓冲；“reportedly”标传闻。

read.title: Equity Raises, Booking Agents, and a Risk Memo
read.text: Wednesday's X brief mixed large financing headlines with travel rules. Meta revised its AI infrastructure equity raise to about 97.5 billion dollars, and AMD said it will invest 1 billion dollars. Separately, OpenAI reportedly plans to buy Google TPUs; the amount was not disclosed. Anthropic said Claude is available to US government users at 40 percent off under OneGov. In travel, Airbnb will stop hosts from requiring big checkout chores for stays booked after November 20, and it will issue temporary phone numbers in the US and Canada. Hilton says it is working with AI booking agents; Skift notes Booking's AI-driven room nights are still under 1 percent. The Federal Reserve was due to announce its rate decision the same day. One account said the S&P excluding AI outperformed the full index by about 6.4 percentage points in October. A same-day risk memo, before the Hong Kong open, said Zhipu was overweight versus its 5 percent position limit and cash was below the 10 percent cash buffer; that memo is language practice material here, not advice. On sentiment, Tencent scored 3.6 with a 'Baidu-ization' narrative, Meituan 9.4 on a small sample, and Zhipu 8.5 after a Tang Jie lecture and a fake 5.5 page was debunked. Kingsoft Cloud had almost no discussion. Xiaomi was dragged by a Yu7 out-of-control video.

write.task:
Write a 120–150 word English paraphrase of a risk memo.
1) Total assets + two position-limit breaches (Zhipu; Kingsoft Cloud combined): %, cap, gap in percentage points. Cash vs cash buffer; cash figure from an October 13 report.
2) Report memo wording (trim at least to 5%; Alibaba plan ~4%; GOOGL do-not-buy; suggest no new orders) with 'According to the memo...' — do not endorse.
3) One X-brief fact (Meta equity raise or OpenAI TPUs with 'reportedly'). End: language practice, not investment advice.
phrases: Zhipu is __%, overweight versus the __% position limit by __ percentage points.
Kingsoft Cloud combined is __%, overweight by __ points.
Cash is __%, __ points below the __% cash buffer.
The memo says ... must be trimmed at least to 5%.
Meta revised its equity raise to about __ billion dollars.
OpenAI reportedly plans to buy Google TPUs.
I am paraphrasing the memo, not giving advice.
